data.long_meaning: In ancient Greek mythology, Artemis was the goddess of the wilderness, the hunt, the wild animals, the mountains, the forests, and the childbirth. Artemus is derived from Artemis, and means 'man's man' or 'butcher' in Greek. It is a name of power and protection. The name Artemus carries the meaning “Man's man, butcher, protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Artemus usually hope their child will grow to embody man's man, butcher, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
